objective:
Deploy one contract, ReedGuardDeployer, on Robinhood Chain: its constructor takes the Robinhood Chain PoolManager 0x8366a39CC670B4001A1121B8F6A443A643e40951, $owner and the fee recipient 0x5Bff2a2FEcD1d6152676813b21346238733bEAB1, takes no salt argument, starts at salt 0 and increments until the CREATE2 address carries the hook's permission flags, then creates ReedGuard in the launch transaction, passing the PoolManager, $owner and fee recipient unchanged to the hook constructor; neither constructor calls any other contract (apart from the deployer creating the hook). There is no deploy function to call afterwards; hook() returns the hook's address. Enable only the callbacks the behavior below needs.
ReedGuard is a standalone Uniswap v4 hook with no new token and no pool of its own; anyone may initialize an eligible pool with it.
Only pools whose currency0 is native ETH may be initialized with this hook; any other initialization reverts.
In this hook, the token is the pool's non-ETH currency and its total supply is that token's totalSupply().
Every pool-dependent view, state, window and limit is keyed by PoolId and isolated per pool; pass the pool id to each pool-dependent function.
The hook does exactly the following, and nothing else:
1. Take 1.0% of the ETH side of every buy and sell as a hook fee, settled in ETH inside the swap that paid it (mint a claim when the PoolManager cannot pay it directly), and send it to 0x5Bff2a2FEcD1d6152676813b21346238733bEAB1. Expose claimFees(PoolId poolId) that anyone may call to redeem that pool's claims using the same distribution. Fees are computed on the amount actually traded; when the swap specifies its ETH amount and the pool fills only part of it, the swap reverts rather than overpaying.
2. The owner may pause and unpause swaps separately by PoolId. Liquidity can always be removed while paused. Expose pause(PoolId poolId) and unpause(PoolId poolId) for the owner and paused(PoolId poolId) as a view.
3. A wallet must wait at least 30 seconds of block timestamp between its swaps in this pool. Track each wallet's next swap time separately by PoolId. Expose nextSwapAt(PoolId poolId, address wallet) as a view. A wallet means tx.origin; several wallets or a shared relayer can defeat the limit.
Owner 0x5bff2a2fecd1d6152676813b21346238733beab1 may only: pause and unpause swaps, through the functions named above. No other admin function, no backend signer, no upgrade path.
Fees are always taken from the ETH (pair currency) side, never from the pool’s token; a fee the PoolManager cannot pay directly is minted as a claim the recipient can redeem. Fee recipient: 0x5Bff2a2FEcD1d6152676813b21346238733bEAB1.
The hook uses no outside pool, token, price feed or service; every price it needs comes from its own pool.
Use mulDiv for every percentage calculation, including fees, shares, limits and price moves, to avoid intermediate multiplication overflow.
Keep the function names exactly as written so the storefront can show them. Composed with The Hooks Store block builder.
